title: Rewind
goalLine: Restore the parcel to its starting arrow.

hints.text: Every tool is its own undo button, but order matters.
To undo a chain of moves, apply the same moves in reverse order.

events.wrong-order: Repeating the original chain in forward order gives the downward arrow instead.

removePhysicsNote: Without reversibility, quantum operations could not be undone by running them in reverse.
